en: A colored panoramic view over a European town nestled in a wide valley surrounded by steep mountains with some snow on the peaks. In the foreground is a fortified complex with a round tower and crenellated walls, and the town spreads out with church steeples and multi‑story buildings. A curving road can be seen to the right. The card has a white border with red printed text at the bottom and along the left edge.
